notes.text: On a phone, you can now scroll the editor's footer clear of the add button, also on short screens.
Lists in the editor now show light rows on a tinted page, as in Material 3.

notes.title: What's new meets you on the start screen
notes.text: After an update, you shouldn't have to look for what's new yourself. The top of the start screen now shows the new version and the main news, with a picture of the biggest one. Tap See what's new to see it all.
